_comment: SahaTakip Slack App manifest. Kullanım: https://api.slack.com/apps -> Create New App -> From a manifest -> workspace seç -> bu JSON'u yapıştır. Sonra Install to Workspace; Bot User OAuth Token (xoxb-) ve Basic Information > Signing Secret'i al; supabase secrets set SLACK_BOT_TOKEN / SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET. request_url'ler slack-webhook fonksiyonudur (proje ref: mdwcasycfssdkogdlbyh).
